name: caption_image
description: Generate a single caption for one image using the Caption module's Florence-2 captioner (or the configured backend). Returns the caption string. Optionally writes a sidecar .txt next to the image.

parameters.name: image_path
parameters.description: Absolute path to an image file (.jpg/.png/.webp/.bmp)

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: Optional trigger word prefix prepended to the caption

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: Force a backend: florence | qwen | joycaption (else config default)

parameters.name: write_txt
parameters.description: Write the caption to <image>.txt alongside the image

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: If write_txt=true and the .txt exists, overwrite it
